description: This file defines a Dart class 'NewsApiClient' responsible for fetching top headlines news articles from the NewsAPI service. It handles API requests, response parsing, error handling, and provides methods to interact with the news API. It also defines an exception class 'NewsApiException' for handling API-related errors.

classes.name: NewsApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class used to represent errors occurring during API interaction, containing an error message and optional HTTP status code.

classes.name: NewsApiClient
classes.description: Main class responsible for communicating with the news API. It manages HTTP requests to fetch top headlines based on country and category, handles API key management, error handling, and response parsing.

methods.name: fetchTopHeadlines
methods.description: Fetches the top news headlines from the API for a given country and optional category. It manages API key validation, constructs the request URI, handles the HTTP request/response cycle, parses the JSON response, and returns a list of NewsArticle objects.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the underlying HTTP client connection, forcing it to close immediately.
